summary.text: Suzanne "Suz" Seymour of Highgate, an independent proprietor and massage therapist, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Vermont's at-large U.S. House seat to Becca Balint.
She received 1.4% of the vote to Becca Balint's 65.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
In Vermont Public's candidate guide, where answers appear as submitted, she listed an age of 64.
